# Deploy the site; exit on the first error.

export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
NAME=${1:-world}
for f in *.md; do
  echo "Processing $f" >&2
  sed -e 's/foo/bar/g' "$f" | grep -v '^#' > "${f%.md}.txt"
done
if [[ -n "$NAME" && $# -gt 0 ]]; then
  printf '%s\n' "Hello, ${NAME}!"
elif [ -f /etc/hosts ]; then
  cat <<EOF > /tmp/out.conf
server_name $NAME;
EOF
fi
